name: todo-api

dependencies.description: Stores users' todo lists, todo items, and list-sharing/collaborator records.
dependencies.name: todo-db

dependencies.description: Validates the caller's Thunder-issued token (via the gateway) and resolves the signed-in user's identity for scoping lists and items.
dependencies.name: user-auth

description: Ballerina REST API owning todo lists, todo items, and list sharing. Enforces that only a list's owner can rename/delete it or manage its collaborators, while owner and collaborators can both manage its items. Sits behind the gateway; does not serve any UI.
